Which booking site listed the lowest prices for West Palm Beach hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 15 West Palm Beach hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 5, the hotel's own site at 2, Traveluro at 2, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, HotelTonight.com at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the West Palm Beach rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 12 of the 12 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at West Palm Beach hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($19 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Holiday Inn Express West Palm Beach Metrocentre by IHG to 14% at Courtyard by Marriott West Palm Beach. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
